title: FreeBSD Distro Variables
description: Configuration variables for FreeBSD distribution synthesis.

FREEBSD_DISTRO_VERSION.description: Target FreeBSD release version to synthesize.

FREEBSD_DISTRO_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to run FreeBSD distro synthesis ('libscript_native' or 'system').

FREEBSD_DISTRO_BUILDWORLD.description: Flag (0 or 1) instructing FreeBSD synthesis to execute buildworld and buildkernel from FREEBSD_SRC_DIR.

FREEBSD_DISTRO_FETCH_BASE.description: Flag (0 or 1) instructing FreeBSD synthesis to download and extract official FreeBSD base.txz and kernel.txz archives.
